Summary: The kingdom of God is God's reign breaking into the world through Jesus, already present wherever Christ is obeyed and not yet complete until He returns. Jesus announced it, taught it in parables, and demonstrated it in healings and deliverance. Believers enter it by new birth and live now as citizens of a kingdom that will never end.
KeyPassages: Daniel 2:44; Mark 1:14-15; Matthew 6:10; Matthew 6:33; Luke 17:20-21; John 3:3-5; Revelation 11:15
RelatedPeople: Daniel; Jesus; John the Baptist; Nicodemus; Paul
RelatedDoctrines: Kingdom of God; Eschatology; Lordship of Christ
RelatedQuestions: What is the kingdom of God?; Is the kingdom of God already here or still coming?
RelatedBooks: Daniel; Matthew; Mark; Luke; John; Revelation
